title: Binance says hackers used fake job interviews and an internal AI tool to pull off the $6.3 billion heist
summary: The largest crypto theft to date was pulled off by combining some well-known hacking techniques over the course of a few months, according to Binance. A postmortem from the company says the process started in June with one developer downloading a tampered installer apparently spread by a malicious Google ad, exposing details about the engineers […]
